device.basis: Byte I2C controller of the X-Processor 4 family: three channels at 0xfff3d000 + 0x1000 n with interrupt lines 65, 66 and 67 (the X-T3 boot-time touch bus is channel 2, at 0xfff3f000, interrupt 0x43). Register layout follows the Fujitsu/Socionext byte I2C master (Linux i2c-synquacer). The completion latency of one byte is a virtual tick count; it is not measured.
